messages:
Maya: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands  what's the one-liner we should use for an engineering buyer?
Leo: 'Redwood makes LLM inference predictable and economical across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments.' Short and practical.
Ivy: Add a single-sentence rebuttal for 'why not use cloud managed endpoints?': 'Cloud endpoints are generic; we optimize kernels, batching, KV caching, and routing so teams get lower unit cost and stable latency without building ops.'
Carlos: From sales: can we get a 1-slide cheat sheet and a canned ROI sentence for Dedicated vs Hosted to use in quick calls?
Maya: Action items: Marketing to draft the cheat sheet (Ivy), Sales to collect two short customer anecdotes (Carlos). ops-bot: Reminder set for 2026-05-15 to check progress.
